howToApply: Candidates must first register on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) under the ‘Student Register/Login’ section.

Candidates can apply for engagement in ONE State/UT only.
Keep the NATS Enrolment ID safe for all future correspondence.
No hard copy of application or documents is to be sent to the Bank’s office.

title: NHAI Recruitment 2026 – Deputy General Manager (Last Date Extended) Posts
shortInfo: NHAI has announced notification for Deputy General Manager (Last Date Extended) posts. Required qualification: B.Tech/B.E. Last date to apply: 19-10-26.

dates.event: Opening Date for Online Registration of Application
Last Date for submission of Online Application (Extended Upto)
Last date for receipt of Print-out of Online Application from Parent Department

howToApply: Visit the NHAI website at http://www.nhai.gov.in and access the link for applying online (use Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox).
Click on the tab: About Us → Vacancies → Current. Click on the relevant Recruitment advertisement and then click ‘Online application’.
Click on ‘APPLY’ – the system will redirect you to the NHAI portal.
Create a registration with: User ID, Password, Name, Phone Number, Email ID, and Aadhaar Card Number (Optional).
Login to the system with the User ID and Password received on your registered e-mail.
Select the post you would like to apply for and fill in the Application Form completely (all fields are mandatory).
Enter your date of birth and retirement age, then press Enter – the system will auto-calculate and populate the next row.

Attach scanned colour passport size photograph, digital signature, essential educational/professional qualifications, and promotion/appointment orders in jpg/jpeg/png/gif/pdf format (not exceeding 1 MB each).
Add educational and experience details in the given box and click ‘Add to List’ after each entry.
Click ‘Preview’ to verify all information entered is correct. Make any necessary changes.
Once everything is correct, click ‘Final Submit’ to save all information.
After submission, note the reference number and download/print the application form.

Get the printed application forwarded by your parent department along with the prescribed ‘Verification Certificate’, certified copies of APARs/ACRs for the last 5 years, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, and no penalty certificate.
Send the duly forwarded application to the respective address at NHAI, Plot No. G5 & 6, Sector-10, Dwarka, New Delhi-110075 on or before 20.10.2026.
Applicants applying for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post.
